lines.text: The Israelites struck down kings and took their lands east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon.
Sihon king of the Amorites lived in Heshbon, and Og was king of Bashan.
Aaron and the Israelites struck down those kings and gave their land as an inheritance to the tribes.
Caleb and the Israelites conquered the kings west of the Jordan, from Baal-gad to Mount Halak.
The kings listed include those of Jericho, Ai, Jerusalem, Hebron, Lachish, Hazor, and Tirzah, thirty-one kings in all.
